functionalTestCases.scenario: Login screen render & accessibility scan
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /
2. Run axe-core accessibility scan.
3. Verify form elements render.
functionalTestCases.expected: Login form renders with email, password fields and Submit button. 0 serious/critical accessibility violations.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered successfully. Axe serious/critical violations: 0.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Login empty submission validation
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Click Submit on empty login form.
2. Observe HTML5 / custom validation trigger.
functionalTestCases.expected: Form submission is blocked and browser displays validation prompt.
functionalTestCases.actual: Submission blocked with message: "Please fill out this field.".

functionalTestCases.scenario: Register screen render & accessibility scan
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /register
2. Run axe-core accessibility scan.
3. Check inputs and terms link.
functionalTestCases.expected: Registration form displays name, email, password, and organization fields without critical errors.
functionalTestCases.actual: Registration rendered. Axe serious/critical violations: 0.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Forgot Password screen render
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /forgot-password
2. Verify email input and reset request button.
functionalTestCases.expected: Forgot password form displays instructions and recovery email input.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered successfully with email input and Back to Login link.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Dashboard asset list rendering & axe-core scan
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard as Owner.
2. Verify seeded assets display in table.
3. Run axe-core scan.
functionalTestCases.expected: Dashboard loads synthetic assets in data table with 0 serious/critical WCAG violations.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered table with rows. Axe violations detected: 2 (color-contrast, label-content-name-mismatch).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Asset search query debounced filtering
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Focus search input.
2. Type "ThinkPad" and submit.
3. Count matching table rows.
functionalTestCases.expected: Table filters down to exactly 1 matching asset (ThinkPad).
functionalTestCases.actual: Table filtered to 1 row(s); first row contains "ThinkPad": true.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Asset search query reset restoration
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Clear search input and submit.
2. Count table rows.
functionalTestCases.expected: Table restores all 3 synthetic assets.
functionalTestCases.actual: Restored row count: 3.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Search empty state feedback
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Submit non-matching query "NONEXISTENT_ITEM_XYZ_999".
2. Verify visible .empty-state h3 message and 0 table rows.
functionalTestCases.expected: UI renders visible empty-state heading "No Assets in this View" with 0 table rows.
functionalTestCases.actual: Heading visible: true ("No Assets in this View"); Table rows: 0.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Browser back and forward button state preservation
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate from Dashboard to Profile.
2. Click browser Back.
3. Assert Dashboard URL.
4. Click browser Forward.
5. Assert Profile URL.
functionalTestCases.expected: Browser history navigates accurately between views without session loss.
functionalTestCases.actual: Back to Dashboard: true; Forward to Profile: true.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Add Asset form rendering & field verification
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /dashboard/add-product
2. Verify input fields.
3. Run axe scan.
functionalTestCases.expected: Add Asset form renders all inputs with 0 serious/critical accessibility violations.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered successfully. Axe violations: 2 (color-contrast, label-content-name-mismatch).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Requisitions list and action buttons verification
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/requisitions
2. Verify REQ-2026-0001 displays.
3. Run axe scan.
functionalTestCases.expected: Requisitions screen displays seeded requisition with 0 serious/critical axe violations.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered requisition. Axe violations: 3 (color-contrast, label-content-name-mismatch, select-name).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Access Management tabs switching & permission review
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/access
2. Click each sublink (Members, Departments, Roles, Company, Security).
3. Assert .page-heading h2 matches expected tab title.
functionalTestCases.expected: All 5 tabs switch and update .page-heading h2 accordingly.
functionalTestCases.actual: Switched through 5/5 tabs cleanly: [members -> "Team Members" (matched: true); departments -> "Departments" (matched: true); roles -> "Roles & Permissions" (matched: true); organization -> "Company & Ownership" (matched: true); security -> "Audit & Security Log" (matched: true)].

functionalTestCases.scenario: Workspace switcher and creation UI rendering
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/workspaces
2. Verify active workspace and create button.
functionalTestCases.expected: Workspaces list shows Synthetic Test Corporation as active workspace.
functionalTestCases.actual: Active workspace displayed with switcher controls.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Dark theme toggle activation and token switching
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Click theme toggle button.
2. Verify dark theme class applied to root.
3. Capture visual snapshot.
functionalTestCases.expected: Page transitions to dark background token with inverted typography colors.
functionalTestCases.actual: Dark theme applied (isDark: true).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Employee role Add Asset action hiding
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Log in as test.employee@example.test.
2. Inspect navigation and action buttons.
3. Assert Add Asset button is hidden.
functionalTestCases.expected: Add Asset button is not visible or accessible to Employee role.
functionalTestCases.actual: Add Asset visible: false.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Employee role direct URL block to Access Management
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Directly navigate to /dashboard/access as Employee.
2. Check redirection or access denied panel.
functionalTestCases.expected: Employee is redirected to /dashboard or shown Access Denied.
functionalTestCases.actual: Access blocked: false (Current URL: http://localhost:5174/dashboard/access). Client router allows navigation without guard.

functionalTestCases.scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Set viewport to 320x800.
2. Measure scrollWidth vs innerWidth.
3. Assert no two-dimensional scrolling.
functionalTestCases.expected: Content reflows without requiring horizontal scrolling (WCAG 1.4.10).
functionalTestCases.actual: FAILED: Requires 2D scrolling. scrollWidth (421px) exceeds viewport (320px) by 101px.

functionalTestCases.scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 200% zoom (640px CSS viewport width)
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Set viewport to 640x800.
2. Measure scrollWidth vs innerWidth.
3. Assert no horizontal scrolling.
functionalTestCases.expected: Page content reflows into single/two-column layout without clipping or horizontal overflow.
functionalTestCases.actual: PASSED: Clean reflow at 640px width (scrollWidth: 640px, innerWidth: 640px, delta: 0px).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Firefox full login flow & dashboard rendering
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Launch Firefox 159.0.
2. Perform login.
3. Verify dashboard table renders.
functionalTestCases.expected: Firefox authenticates and renders dashboard without errors.
functionalTestCases.actual: Login succeeded; dashboard rendered data table cleanly.

functionalTestCases.scenario: WebKit (Safari engine) login & CSS layout compatibility
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Launch WebKit.
2. Perform login.
3. Verify CSS layout.
functionalTestCases.expected: WebKit renders layout cleanly without distortions.
functionalTestCases.actual: WebKit loaded successfully; alignment matches Chromium.

defectLog.title: Asset Register table lacks horizontal scroll container on mobile viewports (< 768px)
defectLog.steps:
1. Open /dashboard on viewport width 320px.
2. Inspect document.documentElement.scrollWidth.
defectLog.expected: No horizontal page scrollbar on mobile; data table enclosed in overflow-x: auto.
defectLog.actual: scrollWidth is 421px on 320px viewport, producing 101px overflow.
defectLog.resolution: Wrap table in <div style="overflow-x: auto; width: 100%; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;">.

defectLog.title: Add Asset form layout causes horizontal viewport overflow on viewports < 480px
defectLog.expected: Form centers within mobile viewport without horizontal overflow.
defectLog.resolution: Set min-width: 0 on .form-center and collapse grid to 1fr on mobile.

defectLog.title: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow failure at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
defectLog.steps:
1. Emulate 400% zoom on 1280px display (320px CSS width).
2. Observe 2D scrolling.
defectLog.resolution: Transform table to responsive card layout or provide touch-scroll container.

defectLog.title: Sidebar navigation section headers fail WCAG 1.4.3 minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio
defectLog.steps:
1. Inspect .nav-section-title in sidebar.
2. Measure text color against background.
defectLog.actual: Foreground #94a3b8 on #ffffff achieves contrast ratio of 2.56:1 (failing 4.5:1).
defectLog.resolution: Darken section header token from #94a3b8 to #64748b (4.6:1).

defectLog.title: Accessible name on user menu button does not contain visual text label (WCAG 2.5.3)
defectLog.steps:
1. Inspect user-menu-trigger in navbar.
2. Compare aria-label with visible text.
defectLog.expected: Accessible name includes the string presented visually ("Test Owner").
defectLog.actual: Button has aria-label="Account menu" while visual text is "Test Owner".
defectLog.resolution: Update aria-label to include visible text: aria-label="Account menu, Test Owner".

defectLog.title: Filter and action select dropdowns lack accessible names (WCAG 4.1.2)
defectLog.steps: 1. Inspect select elements on Requisitions and Access Management.
defectLog.expected: Select controls have accessible labels via <label for="..."> or aria-label.
defectLog.actual: Bare select elements render without accessible name.
defectLog.resolution: Add aria-label attribute to standalone select controls.

defectLog.title: Focus ring suppressed on interactive form inputs (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible)
defectLog.steps:
1. Focus input.
2. Check computed outline style.
defectLog.expected: Visible focus ring outline-style: solid, width >= 2px.
defectLog.actual: Default outline removed (none) with subtle box shadow.

defectLog.title: Modal dialog focus trapping allows Tab navigation to escape into background (WCAG 2.4.3)
defectLog.steps:
1. Open modal.
2. Press Tab.
3. Check focus location.
defectLog.expected: Focus trapped inside modal until dismissed.
defectLog.actual: Focus tabs behind modal into background elements.
defectLog.resolution: Apply inert attribute to root container when modal is open.

defectLog.title: Employee role direct URL navigation to /dashboard/access does not gracefully redirect or deny
defectLog.detectionMethod: Playwright Employee role direct URL navigation
defectLog.steps:
1. Log in as Employee.
2. Directly enter URL /dashboard/access.
defectLog.expected: Client router redirects to /dashboard or displays Access Denied.
defectLog.actual: Client router loads page without guard or feedback.
defectLog.resolution: Add permission check in router loader/element redirecting unauthorized users.
